title: Playback Runtime Boundary Deepening
problem: Nako's source-aware playback/transcode runtime is behaviorally deeper, but `PlaybackAppService` still concentrates HLS artifact serving, support evidence, diagnostics, session orchestration, and lifecycle helper concerns in one broad module.

evidence.summary: Opened the playback runtime boundary deepening refactor lane, selected HLS artifact serving as the first behavior-preserving slice, and split support evidence/store port work into later tasks.
Extracted HLS artifact serving into hls_artifact.rs so PlaybackAppService delegates playlist rewrite, segment readiness, throttled wait, stale segment cleanup, and segment response planning.
Extracted playback support evidence context and runtime diagnostics collection into support.rs without changing Admin/Public wire contracts.
Audited store ports and test locality, kept store trait narrowing out of this lane to avoid pass-through traits, and verified the full playback gate.
Closed the lane with fresh focused gates, final formatting/diff checks, and follow-ons split for execution store ports, adaptive HLS/fMP4, subtitle/audio/HDR maturity, and rsmpeg adapter feasibility.

continue_policy.notes: Closed on 2026-05-28 after behavior-preserving playback runtime boundary deepening. Split feature work such as adaptive HLS, fMP4, rsmpeg adapter replacement, subtitle/HDR execution, and remote workers into separate lanes.
